scope: A requested batch of different concepts with meaningful open authorial choices
preserved: actual requester meaning and prescribed properties
portrait reference limited to visible face and hair
all required visual-semantic components and owner relations
sequence: Resolve the real request and separate prescribed properties from open choices.
Allocate broad interaction strategies and different scene or wardrobe exploration domains as experimental authoring choices.
Each data-blind agent writes brief coherent direction alternatives, including a materially different wardrobe or material realization when these remain open.
The coordinator compares only authorial descriptions and open attributes before any candidate data is read.
Return scoped domain constraints to an arm that repeats the portfolio; do not send other-arm prompts or candidate details.
Finalize the baseline and observable tests, perform embodiment review, and freeze the core and criteria.
Generate one real candidate pack per frozen arm; record exposure, adoption, complete prompt evidence and added render obligations.
Review semantic coherence and portfolio diversity separately before image generation.
When new image generation is requested, review original pixels, diversity, required form, overall impression and user judgment separately.

proposed_batch_gate.additional_scene_requirement: Avoid a single shared social/time archetype when those choices are open; retain each arm's different focal relation.
proposed_batch_gate.application_exception: Exclude requester-prescribed properties from the diversity gate. Never rewrite them to satisfy variety.

criteria_freeze_timing: After the pre-retrieval portfolio checkpoint; never rewrite this completed run's frozen evidence.

source_boundary.precore_allowed: actual request, shared controls, named neutral catalog, limited reference pixels, coordinator-owned experiment allocation and general visual judgment
source_boundary.precore_disallowed: candidate packs, authored profile/candidate registries, indexes, source-specific alias phrases, tests, prior generated outputs or other-arm prompts
source_boundary.already_data_exposed_agent: Use a fresh data-blind successor for a new independent pre-core test. Preserve the old run and label the new lineage explicitly.

keyword_application_test.input: Small predeclared visual-form targets derived from the user's original researched keywords; experimental ownership is explicit.
keyword_application_test.authoring: Use independent natural descriptions; do not feed dictionary IDs or copied source alias phrases to force matches.

controls_comparison.first_followup: Keep the previous creativity=1 setting while testing the workflow checkpoint, so the procedure and control changes are not conflated.
controls_comparison.separate_optional_followup: Compare creativity=2 on another matched batch if requested; increased freedom alone is not a diversity guarantee.
controls_comparison.seed_role: Distinct pack seeds do not impose variation on outfits already authored before retrieval.

implementation_priority: P0: Coordinator briefing, compact direction record and pre-retrieval manual portfolio checkpoint.
P1: A short batch-specific skill instruction and a separate generic portfolio check; no new preset outfit menu.
P2: Investigate frozen observation delivery and paraphrase/ranking gaps in a separate retrieval change.
